description: Source code implementing various Composer classes for OpenGL rendering, including Blitter and different composition strategies like opaque, blend, and shrink variants.

classes.name: Blitter
classes.description: Handles OpenGL blitting operations, including setup and rendering of textured quads.

classes.name: ComposerBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for compositors, providing setup and teardown functionality.

classes.name: NoComp
classes.description: A no-operation compositor that does nothing.

classes.name: OpaqueComp
classes.description: A compositor that renders textures opaquely.

classes.name: OpaqueShrinkComp
classes.description: A compositor that renders textures with shrinking effect, toggling parity for variation.

classes.name: BlendComp
classes.description: A compositor that blends textures with transparency.

classes.name: BlendShrinkComp
classes.description: A blending compositor with shrinking effect and parity toggle.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the compositor or blitter with necessary resources.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, default is empty.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Performs the composition of textures onto the framebuffer.

methods.name: nocomp
methods.description: Creates and returns a no-operation compositor instance.

methods.name: opaque
methods.description: Creates and returns an opaque rendering compositor.

methods.name: opaqueShrink
methods.description: Creates and returns a shrinking opaque compositor.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Creates and returns a blending compositor.

methods.name: blendShrink
methods.description: Creates and returns a shrinking blending compositor.
